global: This miso ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender noodles and crisp menma, topped with finely sliced scallions. Served in a rustic ceramic bowl with Japanese script, it rests on a warm wooden table under soft, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain patterns with visible texture and natural wood lines.
regions.bowl: The ceramic ramen bowl has a brown rim, off-white interior, and black Japanese characters on its surface.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with sliced green onions, appears rich, golden-brown, and glossy with visible noodle strands.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as light brown, slightly translucent, elongated strips with a fibrous, textured surface.
